::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 30th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 14
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Many thanks for [this payment](organizations/other_160.qmd), which considering that I had £400 before ought indeed to satisfy me.

I wonder when [Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd) means to go on with the [Scripture readings](cmy_books/cmybook_87.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** The final volume of CMY's *Scripture Readings* was not in fact published until 1879, but that this was entirely the printer's fault is not certain.
